The year '''16,782 Before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] ([[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]])''' was a year in the [[Indecta Era]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In the years following the [[First Alsakan Conflict|first]] [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflict]], the Republic's [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] expansion came to a near halt. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], however, the [[Celebratus Archive]] was founded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]]. The archive grew to include complete records for over 300,000 different [[Species/Legends|species]]. Its creation helped to build the reputation of Obroa-skai, and the library itself [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy|gained fame]] nearly [[10,000 BBY|7,000 years later]].

==Proem==
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] boom and expansion during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] had come to an abrupt end in [[17,000 BBY]] with the outbreak of the [[First Alsakan Conflict|first]] [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflict]]. The fighting marked the beginning of the [[Indecta Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the Republic that saw little [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] growth and expansion. As the Indecta Era continued, however, the Republic began to make contact with previously unknown [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who lived on the Rimward frontier, increasing the diversity of the [[Galactic community|known]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="EA" />

==The galaxy in 16,782 BBY==
In the year 16,782 BBY, as the Indecta Era continued, the library known as the [[Celebratus Archive]] was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]]. The archive was a massive collection that featured complete records of over 300,000 [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="EA" />

==Impact==
The creation of the Celebratus Archive helped to secure the reputation of Obroa-skai as a primary center for research. The massive archive was also remembered in [[10,000 BBY]] by the historian [[Vicendi]], who included the library in his list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]], a part of the text ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]'', which was written as an homage to the founding of the Republic.<ref name="EA" />

==Notable events==
*The Celebratus Archive was established on Obroa-skai.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
16,782 BBY was mentioned in [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]'s [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" />
